tools.name: look-up-latin-word
tools.title: Look up Latin Word
tools.description: Look up a Latin word in the Gaffiot 2016 Latin-French dictionary and get its complete French definition, with citations of Latin authors and references

ai.instructions: The Gaffiot is a Latin-French dictionary: headwords are in Latin, definitions are in French. Before calling look-up-latin-word, convert inflected forms to their dictionary form (nominative singular for nouns and adjectives, first person singular present indicative for verbs), e.g. 'amavit' -> 'amo', 'rosarum' -> 'rosa', 'tulit' -> 'fero'. If no entry is found, try other plausible dictionary forms or the returned suggestions. Base your answer on the returned entries rather than on general knowledge. When quoting a definition, quote the French text as it is; if the user writes in another language, you may add a translation, clearly presented as yours. Always credit the source as: Gaffiot 2016 (G. Gréco et al.), CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
